statement: The sustained-write-throughput memory-soak path honors a duration long enough for configured warmup plus analysis and fails closed when required per-node analysis is deferred, insufficient, under-sampled, or detects a leak.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The sustained-write-throughput workload must honor configured duration and cannot finish before the configured warmup plus analysis window can complete.
When requireSamples is true, deferred, insufficient, under-sampled, missing, or unanalyzed per-node evidence is a hard failure rather than a passing or advisory outcome.
The deterministic oracle requires every node to report analyzed true, at least 30 samples, no insufficient-* reason, and no detected leak, and must go red when each enforcement branch is reverted.
The 20-minute-plus distributed soak is a downstream certification run only; route any failure to an owner-level deterministic reproduction before rerunning it.
